response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment (fracture of the distal radius) resulting from an accident during a trip (skiing). Clause A4.1 covers reasonable and necessary medical expenses, including treatment for acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication of pre-existing conditions or planned treatment, so clause A5.1 or A5.2 does not apply."}
